name: Ushiro Anju
source:
Mysterious 3rd year transfer student right after Eil. He is very popular among girls because of his good looking and gentle demeanor. He seems to care about Eil for some reason.

[spoiler]He is actually an Angel too and Eil's boss. He comes to watch over Eil since he is worried about her.[/spoiler]
